evidence.fact: Serafimer-, Svärds- and Nordstjärneordnarna were established by King Fredrik I in 1748.
evidence.summary: Official royal-house history states that the three orders were established in 1748.

evidence.fact: Serafimerorden is Sweden's foremost order and has one class, riddare.
evidence.summary: Official overview describes the order as one-class; the displayed object page identifies the pictured type as a knight's breast star.
